p2d2Defect: src/composition/execution_association.ts returned bare null for EVERY refusal, so a failed TREATMENT was indistinguishable from OFF at the worker boundary (F4).
correction: the provider now records the assigned arm, the source eligibility and the delivery state independently; null is returned ONLY for the OFF arm.

observedResults.readerUnavailable: assignedArm TREATMENT, eligibility SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, deliveryState DELIVERY_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET, failureReason present
observedResults.budgetRefusal: assignedArm TREATMENT, eligibility QUALIFIED, capsule null on the budget path
observedResults.neverDeliveryDisabled: asserted: a missing TREATMENT is never DELIVERY_DISABLED without its assigned-arm fact
